'''James Hall My (Test ) Bring Him Before Me''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[James Hall]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-20296">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/20296 My (Test ) Bring Him Before Me], DeckTech (James "Newk" Hall, 29 December 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/20296/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/20296/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016212227/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/20296/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[James Hall]]
* '''Published:''' 29 December 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''My (Test ) Bring Him Before Me''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Start Your Engines!|Tat-D-startyourengines.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 BHBM Hall DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' i play the usual BHBM. I play with AT-ATs and docking bays. Im trying to find good tricks to play so if you have any suggestions tell me.

== Original post ==

'''My (Test ) Bring Him Before Me'''
* '''Author:''' James "Newk" Hall
* '''Published:''' December 29, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' i play the usual BHBM. I play with AT-ATs and docking bays. Im trying to find good tricks to play so if you have any suggestions tell me.

=== Strategy ===

Well I already said that I play it normally. Probably the only thing I didnt say was that I was racing. Not a big change. Thanks for rating my deck.
